problems: The blind guess (standing human figure) does not match The Iron Kettle. Only the weaker alternative, a vase-shaped vessel, is close, and the drawing reads as a kettle mainly because of the spout, lid, bail and flames.
The gold lines form a thin wireframe polygon of the key stars rather than a filled silhouette. The blue outline is the only silhouette-like shape, and it is faint.

Several labels collide and overlap: 'the knob on top of the lid' with 'left end of the bail', 'rim of the body' with 'outer curve of the bail', 'where the spout meets the left wall' with 'lower left of the body', and 'centre tongue of flame' with the flame outline. This makes the part assignments hard to read.

The lid and knob stars (24327, 24244) sit close together at the top, and the left bail end (24845) sits at the lid's left lug, which is roughly right, but the bail arc is drawn as a long diagonal from the lid's right side rather than a clear handle arc.
The right wall star (23362) is placed off to the far right, detached from the body outline, so it does not read as where the bail meets the wall.
The flame tongues are drawn as thin rectangles with the centre tongue star at the bottom point, which reads acceptably as flames under the kettle.
The figure is the right way up: spout on the left, lid and knob at top, flames at the bottom.
output.advice: Redraw so the kettle reads without the title. Make the body a clear rounded vessel with a filled or thick silhouette outline, not only thin blue lines. Put the spout as a visible tapered tube from the left wall up to star 25985 at the tip. Put the lid as a dome with the knob (24244) on top and crown (24327) at the dome's peak, and keep the rim star (24305) just under the lid. Draw the bail as a clear arc that starts at the left lug (24845), rises above the lid, and lands on the right wall at 23362, with 23231 at its top and 22479 on its outer curve. Keep the base and foot (23685, 24927) at the bottom corners of the body. Place three flame tongues below the body, with the tallest at 24505 in the centre. Fix the label collisions by offsetting labels into open space with leader lines, and keep the frame centred and upright."]
